selection_reasoning: This forms a 3-step multi-hop chain: (1) The agent must first locate an orange banner that serves as a landmark/waypoint marking the path to resources. (2) Near the orange banner area, acacia logs are available to mine — the agent needs to chop acacia wood. (3) The mined acacia logs are converted to acacia planks, which are then used to craft a bowl (3 planks in a V shape). This creates a natural explore→gather→craft progression that is coherent and verifiable.

edges.reason: The orange banner marks the location of the acacia trees; agent must find it first to navigate to the logging area
Crafting a bowl requires 3 wooden planks, which are obtained by converting the acacia logs mined in the previous step

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange banner is placed at spawn-relative (4, 0, 6). The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the banner.

Uses inventory_has because mining acacia logs drops acacia_log items into the player's inventory. The player starts with no acacia logs, so having at least 1 confirms they mined one. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because the item ending up in inventory is the most reliable signal.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a bowl places it into the player's inventory. The player starts with no bowls and must craft one from acacia planks (derived from mined acacia logs) at the crafting table. Having at least 1 bowl in inventory confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing with an orange banner serving as a landmark, marking a small grove of acacia logs. A crafting table is placed nearby for crafting. The player spawns with a wooden axe to mine the logs. The progression is: spot the orange banner → walk to it and mine the nearby acacia logs → use the crafting table to craft a bowl from acacia planks.
task_text: Find the orange banner landmark, then mine acacia logs near it using your wooden axe, and craft a bowl at the nearby crafting table.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin facing +Z. Orange banner at (4,0,6) is visible from spawn. Acacia logs form 3 'trees' at (6,0-3,9), (8,0-3,10), and (7,0-2,8). Crafting table at (5,0,10) is near the logs. The 20x20 grass platform with air above ensures no natural terrain blocks interfere. Player has wooden axe to mine logs efficiently. 11 acacia log blocks total provide more than enough wood (need 3 planks = 1 log minimum, but extras ensure task is achievable even with mistakes).
